sn55.23:1.2: Atha Kho Mahānāmo sakko yena Godhā sakko tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Godhaṃ sakkam etad avoca || || 3.
sn55.23:1.3: Katīhi tvam Godhe dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānasi || avinipātadhāmmaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyanan ti || ||
sn55.23:2.1: Tīhi khvāham Mahānāma dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avinipātadhammam niyatam sambodhiparāyanaṃ || ||
sn55.23:2.3: Idha Mahānāma ariyāsavako Buddha aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.23:2.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.23:2.7: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || la-[pe] || anuttaram puññakhettaṃ lokassā ti || ||
sn55.23:2.8: Imehi khvāham Mahānāma tīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi || avinipātadhammam niyataṃ sambodhiparāyanaṃ || || 5.
sn55.23:3.1: Tvam pana Mahānāma katīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannaṃ puggalam ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyatam sambodhiparāyanan ti || ||
sn55.23:3.2: Catuhi khvāham bho Godhe dhammehi samannāgatam sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyanaṃ ||
sn55.23:3.4: Idha Godhe ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn55.23:3.5: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.23:3.8: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.23:3.9: Imehi khvāham Godhe catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyanan ti || || 6.
sn55.23:4.1: Āgamehi tvam Mahānāma āgamehi tvam Mahānāma ||
sn55.23:4.2: Bhagavā va etaṃ jāneyya etehi dhammehi samannāgatam vā asamannāgataṃ vā ti || ||
sn55.23:4.3: Āyāma Godhe yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkameyyāma || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato etam attham ārocessāmā ti || || 7.
sn55.23:4.4: Atha kho Mahānāmo sakko Godhā ca sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdiṃsu || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 8.
sn55.23:5.1: Idhāham bhante yena Godhā sakko tenupasaṅkamiṃ || upasaṅkamitvā Godhaṃ sakkam etad avocaṃ ||
sn55.23:5.2: katīhi tvaṃ Godhe dhammehi samannāgatam sotāpannam puggalam ājānāsi avinipāta- ni- sambodhi- || ||
sn55.23:5.3: Evam vutte bhante Godhā sakkho mam etad avoca || ||
sn55.23:6.1: Tīhi khvāham Mahānāma dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avi- ni- sambodhi- ||
sn55.23:6.3: Idha Mahānāma ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn55.23:6.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.23:6.7: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || la-pe || anuttaram puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti || ||
sn55.23:6.8: Imehi khvāham Mahānāma tīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avi- ni- sambodhi- || ||
sn55.23:6.9: Tvam pana Mahānāma katīhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannam puggalam ājānāsi avini- ni- sambodhiparāyanan ti || || 9.
sn55.23:7.1: Evaṃ vuttāham bhante Godham sakkam etad avocam || ||
sn55.23:7.2: Catuhi khvāham Godhe dhammehi samannāgatam sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avi- ni- sambodhi- || ||
sn55.23:7.4: Idha Godhe ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || ||
sn55.23:7.5: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam Buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.23:7.8: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.23:7.9: Imehi khvāhaṃ Godhe catuhi dhammehi samannāgatam sotāpannam puggalam ājānāmi avini- ni- sambodhiparāyanan ti || ||
sn55.23:8.1: Evam vutte bhante Godhā sakko mam etad avoca ||
sn55.23:8.2: Āgamehi tvam Mahānāma āgamehi tvam Mahānāma ||
sn55.23:8.3: Bhagavā va etam jāneyya etehi dhammehi samannāgatam vā asamannāgataṃ vā ti || || 10.
sn55.23:8.4: Idha bhante kocid eva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya || ekato assa Bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho ||
sn55.23:8.6: evam pasannam mam bhante Bhagavā dhāretu || || 11.
sn55.23:8.7: Idha bhante kocid eva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya || ekato assa Bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho bhikkhunīsaṅgho ca
sn55.23:8.9: evam pasannam mam bhante Bhagavā dhāretu || || 12.
sn55.23:8.10: Idha bhante kocid eva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya || ekato assa Bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho bhikkhunīsaṅgho upāsakā ca
sn55.23:8.12: evam pasannam mam bhante Bhagavā dhāretu || || 13.
sn55.23:8.13: Idha bhante kocid eva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya || ekato assa Bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho bhikkhu nīsaṅgho upāsakā upāsikāyo ca
sn55.23:8.15: evam pasannam mam bhante Bhagavā dhāretu || || 14.
sn55.23:8.16: Idha bhante kocid eva dhammasamuppādo uppajjeyya || ekato assa Bhagavā ekato bhikkhusaṅgho bhikkhu nīsaṅgho upāsakā upāsikāyo sadevako ca loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇapajā sadevamanussā ||
sn55.23:8.18: evam pasannaṃ mam bhante Bhagavā dhāretū ti || || 15.
sn55.23:8.19: Evaṃvādiṃ tvam Godhe Māhānāmaṃ sakkaṃ kiṃ vadesī ti || ||
sn55.23:8.20: Evaṃvādāham bhante Mahānāmaṃ sakkaṃ na kiñci vadāmi aññatra kalyāṇā aññatra kusalā ti || || 1.
